mentions.name: Teasel Tools
mentions.description: A single platform that connects lab instruments to AI assistants, replacing several disjoint MCP servers; it structures the approach of using AI for hardware development. Demonstrated by connecting a repaired vintage Philips PM5190 function generator to Claude Code.
mentions.problem: The author's earlier experiments used several disjoint MCP servers; this consolidates them into one comprehensive, structured platform for AI-driven hardware development.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am now trying to make my approach a little bit more comprehensive and structured, instead of several disjoint MCP servers, a single platform that connects lab instruments to AI assistants: https://teasel.tools/
